stories.title: Discover authorized Accounts
stories.outcome: Show environment/Principal-bound Account IDs and safe names in deterministic order, allowing equal names but rejecting duplicate IDs. Preserve version/time/readiness and distinguish complete zero membership from loading, partial, stale and failed discovery.

stories.title: Select an Account workspace explicitly
stories.outcome: Require explicit selection even for one Account. Produce a local intent only for an ID in the exact displayed snapshot; reject changed or rebound evidence. Activation separately enforces authorization, and MCP uses bounded request/session context.

stories.title: Remember workspace preference without automatic activation
stories.outcome: Remember the last Account only within the same environment and Principal. If still visible it may sort first, but it never becomes automatically selected or grants access; ignore a missing remembered ID without disclosure.

stories.title: Fail workspace selection without disclosure
stories.outcome: Use bounded non-enumerating failures. If cached discovery is retained on failure, label it stale or partial. Reject malformed or rebound evidence and expose no credentials, provider paths, financial values or hidden membership details.

stories.title: Resolve rejected work before ordinary logout
stories.outcome: Preserve unresolved rejected operations across restart and ordinary logout. Implement a retry or acknowledgment only after O-051 settles responsibility transfer; closing review never resolves or deletes accepted work.

stories.title: Create a Project for an existing Client
stories.outcome: Create a stable-ID Project for the selected same-Account Client with validated name, optional description, eligible categories and exact nullable allocations as one durable observable result. Duplicate names are valid. Media reconciles separately; expose accepted/pending/rejected state, never silent partial setup.

stories.title: Browse Projects
stories.outcome: Browse same-Account Active/Archived Projects with alphabetical cards, Client/hero display, create entry and honest readiness. Active's Inventory card opens Account-scoped Items/Transactions/Spaces with remembered section and shared child workflows, never a fake Project. Budget preview and planning remain separate.

stories.title: Open Project detail
stories.outcome: Open the exact same-Account Project with honest readiness and routes to Item, Transaction, Space, Notes, Budget, Invoicing and Reports workflows. Compose the separately verified financial Transaction browser and owning mutations; host navigation alone never proves totals, financial visibility or write authority.

stories.title: Rename a Project
stories.outcome: Rename only the selected Project under the approved name, role, archived/same-value and revision rules. Preserve Client identity, description, media, categories, lifecycle, children and accounting; those use separate operations. Never use rename as ownership reassignment.

stories.title: Archive a Project
stories.outcome: Confirm the selected active Project and observed revision; stale selection/revision invalidates confirmation. Offline confirmation durably accepts archive and moves it from Active to Archived as pending. Preserve children/history, allow cancel and show failure; this action never also restores.

stories.title: Apply the Project deletion policy
stories.outcome: A synchronized Project cannot be physically removed in a way that orphans history or dependent records.

stories.title: Browse scoped active Spaces
stories.outcome: List active Spaces in one exact Account/Project-or-Inventory scope with deterministic case-insensitive name order, display-name/ID ties and distinct duplicate names. Open exact-ID detail; distinguish empty, incomplete, stale, failed and disappeared data. Search and full card evidence are separate obligations.

stories.title: Create a direct Space
stories.outcome: Create one stable-ID Space in immutable Project or Inventory scope with validated name and optional notes, duplicate names allowed. Preserve Create/Cancel and drafts on failure; durably accept offline intent, then validate current membership and exact parent. No template, media, checklist or Item side effects.

stories.title: Toggle a Space checklist item
stories.outcome: Toggle the selected stable-ID task from exact scoped checklist evidence, durably offline with visible pending/rejection. Preserve other tasks and order; detect competing edits instead of silently replacing newer state. This never sets Space reconciliation completion or accounting.

stories.title: Edit and save Space checklists
stories.outcome: Add, rename, remove and order checklists/items; edit text and checked state. Save one complete stable-ID replacement against the expected Space revision; stale concurrent edits conflict atomically. Empty collections/lists are valid. Cancel only an unaccepted draft; accepted work remains durable.

stories.title: Show checklist progress
stories.outcome: Derive per-list and aggregate checked/total counts from the same represented checklist state. Empty lists and collections are valid and must not divide by zero or imply completed reconciliation. Show unknown/incomplete evidence honestly, not fabricated zero or completion.

stories.title: Manage shared Space templates
stories.outcome: Browse active ordered templates with name, optional notes and checklist count. Add/edit name, notes and checklist structure; cancel retains data. Authorized save, archive and reorder have durable visible outcomes, not silent independent writes. Reset stored checked state; shared grants remain O-026.

stories.title: Assign or move Items to a Space
stories.outcome: Assign selected stable-ID Items atomically/idempotently to an active same-scope Space using exact Item and destination evidence. Replacing placement closes old-photo green Item checkmark links without deleting photos/bytes; derive links server-side. Red review notes and accounting remain unchanged.

stories.title: Remove a Space without losing placement evidence
stories.outcome: Ordinary removal is archive, never source hard delete. Confirm/cancel the exact Space and expose durable outcomes; resolve assigned-Item and historical-reference behavior under O-037 before implementation. Do not silently clear placement or leave hidden unexplained Space IDs.

stories.title: Use canonical Client identity
stories.outcome: Use one opaque account-scoped Client identity with current name, archive state and audit timestamps. Every target Project references a same-Account clientId; display text never authorizes ownership, and frozen paid/report name snapshots survive later Client rename.

stories.title: Rename a Client without rewriting history
stories.outcome: Edit the Client's name once and update current Project display from that identity; never independently rename the Project's Client text or rewrite frozen Invoices, reports or paid history. Archived/same-value rename and the exact name contract remain gated.

stories.title: Create or select a Client for a Project
stories.outcome: Project creation selects an active same-Account Client or creates one, then stores its clientId and derived current display. A new Client name must satisfy one exact app/MCP/Postgres contract.

stories.title: Archive a Client without deleting history
stories.outcome: Archive any Client that has Projects or accounting history, hide it from new-Project selection, and preserve its identity and every historical relationship instead of hard-deleting it.

stories.title: Correct Project ownership or merge duplicate Clients
stories.outcome: Use the approved correction/merge workflow for mistaken Project clientId or duplicate Clients, preserving Transfer eligibility, accounting ownership and frozen history. Never treat ownership reassignment as a text edit.

stories.title: Enforce the global Transaction taxonomy
stories.outcome: Write only scope-relative Purchase and Return plus project-only same-Client non-cash Transfer. Pending credits, Fees, Expenses and hidden inventory sale/return occurrences never become extra Transaction types.

stories.title: Transfer Items between same-Client Projects
stories.outcome: One authorized app/MCP command atomically moves source Items to another active Project in the same Account with the same non-null Client ID, writing both records and current accounting/placement. No Inventory hop or invented cash/demand. Retries return the original result; stale concurrent changes fail closed.

stories.title: Preserve paired Transfer evidence
stories.outcome: Atomically create inseparable source/destination Transfer records with one correlation ID, exact same-Client and Project roles, counterpart IDs, immutable Item/basis/open-or-paid snapshots, actor/time and later correction provenance.

stories.title: Reallocate budget through Transfer
stories.outcome: Apply equal negative/positive line-level effects using each Item's open amount or frozen paid basis, decide mixed batches per Item, retain Furnishings and freeze the basis against later price drift. Transfer evidence never double-counts an open charge; Client-wide recognized value stays net zero.

stories.title: Choose and confirm an eligible Transfer destination
stories.outcome: Bulk-select source Items and offer only other active same-Account Projects with the exact non-null Client ID; exclude Inventory, source and unresolved/different Clients. Confirm both Projects, Client, Items, live-Invoice changes, budget effects and blocked reasons before one all-or-nothing action.

stories.title: Move an uncollected Item obligation between Projects
stories.outcome: Move the same open charge, occurrence identity and amount basis from source to destination; remove an exact created-Invoice line and recalculate when applicable. Shift only unpaid budget attribution and create neither a source credit nor a destination purchase/charge duplicate.

stories.title: Reattribute a paid Item without rewriting payment history
stories.outcome: Keep the source paid Invoice, Purchase, frozen line and historical membership unchanged; create no credit, charge or purchase. Paired Transfer lines apply equal negative/positive frozen paid allocations while current placement shows the destination and history retains the source.

stories.title: Handle live Invoice edge cases during Transfer
stories.outcome: Keep an emptied created/sent source Invoice noncollectible and apply the approved zero-total lifecycle. For sent Invoices, apply the approved removal/recall and revision/delivery policy. Never leave a transferred line on the wrong Project Invoice or collect an invalid revision.

stories.title: Apply Project-specific Additional Requests state on Transfer
stories.outcome: Use the approved preserve, clear or destination-reselection rule for the non-additive Additional Requests tag; never silently treat Project-contextual tag state as ownership identity or extra spend.

stories.title: Resolve destination Space during Transfer
stories.outcome: Clear the incompatible source Space and apply the approved optional destination-Space assignment policy with exact destination-scope validation; never retain or guess a foreign Space reference.

stories.title: Correct a completed Transfer as one paired event
stories.outcome: Use the approved reversal/correction workflow without deleting or independently mutating either paired record; preserve downstream dependencies, audit provenance and equal/opposite accounting.

stories.title: Place a later paid-Item credit after Transfers
stories.outcome: After one or more same-Client Transfers, use the approved Project to host a later Client credit while tracing its amount/category through the Transfer chain to the original frozen paid line; never rewrite the original payment.

stories.title: Migrate Project ownership to reviewed Client identities
stories.outcome: Import immutable exports into isolated target staging; review name-match suggestions without guessing identity. Preserve source/frozen names, populate reviewed same-Account clientId and disable unresolved Transfers. Target creation, search, pickers, reports, editing and MCP use IDs; no Firebase backfill.

stories.title: Interpret legacy Transaction values without extending target writes
stories.outcome: Import decodes legacy sale/paymentToBusiness/fee/expense/to-inventory evidence and maps or quarantines it without inventing cash. Target app/MCP present the mapped meaning and write only three canonical types; source interpretation and minimum posting evidence require an approved, reconcilable mapping.

stories.title: Route money and billable activity canonically
stories.outcome: Preserve New Transaction's applicable inputs, review/Back/Cancel, validation, durable pending/failure/success and exact detail route. Client-paid money enters Project Transactions; 1584 goods/costs enter Inventory/Invoicing. Collection and Transfer use their owning flows, not generic legacy payment/sale writes.

stories.title: Browse the Project Invoicing workspace
stories.outcome: Browse canonical Items/credits, Expenses, Fees and Invoices with disclosure, query, eligible source/status filters, pipeline/detail routes and empty/readiness states. Use owning commands for lifecycle actions; summary values are separate. Movement records remain provenance, not a user-facing source type.

stories.title: Build a live Invoice from stable source records
stories.outcome: Curate stable Item, Expense, Fee and supported-credit identities into one live Invoice; each source belongs to at most one uncanceled uncollected Invoice, live source changes update totals, and only whole-Invoice collection is supported.

stories.title: Collect a whole Invoice
stories.outcome: Collect one positive whole Invoice atomically: validate actual payment, freeze lines and category allocations, create one Purchase, retain paid membership, and remove collected sources from active queues without relocating Items.

stories.title: Preserve immutable paid history
stories.outcome: Collected Invoice membership and accounting evidence remain immutable and auditable.

stories.title: Show paid and unpaid budget progress
stories.outcome: Collection moves value from unpaid to paid without increasing total spend, with signed credits represented honestly.

stories.title: Correct accounting and issue refunds without story confusion
stories.outcome: Physical movement, vendor refund, Client cash refund, pending credit, and accounting correction remain distinct operations.

stories.title: Sell an Inventory Item to a Project
stories.outcome: Move the Item to the destination Project; create a new Furnishings charge and sale occurrence at project price, increasing unpaid progress without a Transaction. Approved uncollected price edits atomically update the charge and created/sent Invoice total; collected amounts stay frozen.

authority.section: Story 1: Sell an Inventory Item to a Project

stories.title: Remove an Item before invoicing
stories.outcome: Return the Item to Inventory, remove its uninvoiced positive charge and unpaid Furnishings progress, and link the return to the reversed sale occurrence. Retain audit history; create no Invoice, credit or project Transaction.

authority.section: Story 2: Decide Not to Use It Before It Is on an Invoice

stories.title: Remove an Item from a live Invoice
stories.outcome: Return the Item to Inventory and atomically remove its exact occurrence line and charge, recalculate live Invoice totals/category allocation and unpaid progress, and retain edit/return history. No cash Transaction; a resulting zero Invoice is noncollectible. Sent revision policy remains open.

authority.section: Story 3: Remove It from a Created or Sent Invoice

stories.title: Credit a paid Item
stories.outcome: Return a paid Item to Inventory, preserving its paid Invoice, line, Transaction and historical membership. Create one retry-safe credit linked to the original paid line and return, using frozen amount/category and immediately reducing Furnishings progress. No cash refund or settlement is implied.

authority.section: Story 4: Remove It after the Invoice Was Paid

stories.title: Sell the same Item again
stories.outcome: Resell the same physical Item to the same or another Project using a new charge and occurrence, destination project price and Furnishings attribution. Never reuse a prior occurrence or reopen earlier charge, credit, Invoice or paid Transaction history.

authority.section: Story 5: Sell the Same Item Again

stories.title: Move a Project-originated Item into Inventory
stories.outcome: Acquire the Project-originated Item into Inventory at purchase cost, never inflated project price. Freeze source Project/category/amount/origin; remove unpaid demand or create a linked paid credit and reduce Project progress immediately. Physical entry alone creates no cash Purchase or client refund.

authority.section: Story 6: Sell a Project-Originated Item to Business Inventory

stories.title: Return an Item to its source Project
stories.outcome: Return only to the proven source Project using immutable inventory-entry amount/category, creating a new positive charge and occurrence and increasing unpaid progress. No different destination or recalculated basis within Return; ambiguous provenance requires ordinary Sell or a block, never guessing.

authority.section: Story 7: Return a Project-Originated Item to Its Source Project

stories.title: Move an Item across Clients through Inventory
stories.outcome: One action removes source unpaid demand or credits its frozen paid basis, passes the Item through Inventory with correlated provenance, and creates destination demand at destination project price. Update both budgets atomically; never share accounting records or offer this in the same-Client Transfer picker.

authority.section: Story 9: Sell from Project A to a Different Client's Project through Inventory

stories.title: Correct an Item lifecycle mistake
stories.outcome: Before collection, correct a mistaken placement that did not represent an economic scope change: atomically repair placement and open charge/Invoice and void or reverse the exact erroneous occurrence with audit metadata. Invent no sale, return, cash or budget event; never use this to edit paid history.

stories.title: Return an Item to an outside vendor
stories.outcome: For an actual vendor refund, create a Return in the direct-paying Client’s Project or 1584’s Inventory scope. If the Item was also billed to a Project, separately remove its unpaid demand or create its paid credit. Vendor cash and client credit are distinct; posting evidence remains gated.

authority.section: Story 11: Return an Item to an Outside Vendor

stories.title: Create one real Item through the unified wizard
stories.outcome: All entry points share form state, validation and one real-Item writer. Show photos, name, notes, quantity (may default to one), Project/optional Space first; save or continue without replacing identity. Minimum name/image/note validation, payer hint and one-screen versus two-step layout remain open.

stories.title: Show whether an Item is Accounted For
stories.outcome: Derive project accounting state from an actual client-paid Purchase or billable charge/credit occurrence, including live and frozen paid history. Space, status, completeness and Invoice selection/sent state do not decide it. Inventory acquisition completeness is separate; a cached flag is not authority.

stories.title: Link an Item as Client paid
stories.outcome: Idempotently Link an Unaccounted For Item still in the Project to its eligible actual client-paid Purchase; validate account/Project/type/mutability atomically. Reconcile category to Furnishings/approved rule; preserve ID/media/notes/quantity/Space. Mark Accounted For without Invoicing demand.

stories.title: Link an Item as Business paid
stories.outcome: Idempotently Link an Unaccounted For project Item to one positive Furnishings charge at approved project price, preserving ID/media/notes/quantity/Space. Inventory Purchase is optional, stays inventory-scoped/unrepriced and is created only by a separate explicit action, never fabricated. No project Transaction.

stories.title: Preserve one Item identity
stories.outcome: Project Items and Invoicing reference one physical Item. Its separate charge occurrence owns signed amount, category, Invoice state and paid history. Adding details or Link never replaces the Item ID; duplicate-evidence reconciliation is a separate audited action, not a routine Link step.

stories.title: Import legacy proto Item evidence
stories.outcome: Atomically resolve each legacy proto to one Item or blocking quarantine without partial records; honor valid convertedItemId and durable source correlation. Retry without duplicate Items or media copies. Preserve media/notes/quantity/Space; explicit copy/reuse cannot orphan bytes. No target proto writer or dual-read.

stories.title: Reject stale source writers at cutover
stories.outcome: At the explicitly authorized hard cutover, protect final export/delta with a fail-closed source write freeze; prove quiescence, late offline-writer rejection and pending/rejected-work recovery before target activation. No Firebase v2 adapter, dual write or intermediate redesign release.

stories.title: Create and edit budget category definitions
stories.outcome: Preserve Add/Edit, name, General/Itemized/Fee, behavior info, Exclude from Overall, Save/Cancel and duplicate feedback. Apply one authorized stable-ID revision-safe command; protect seeded/system meaning and used-history dependencies. Name rules remain O-056; silent source writes are not success.

stories.title: Manage enabled Project categories and allocations
stories.outcome: Use one shared allocation command from Project setup/edit and Manage Budget. Preserve selected-category inputs, included-overall preview, added/removed/changed and unchanged-skip behavior. Save an exact revision-bound result with absent, enabled-null and explicit-zero semantics; never auto-enable silently.

stories.title: Calculate budget progress
stories.outcome: Compute each category from direct Client-paid records and frozen collected allocations plus open Item charges/credits, Expenses and Fees. Collection changes paid/unpaid composition, never total. Same-Client Transfer is net zero; unresolved category/provenance prevents an authoritative complete total.

stories.title: Apply budget sign conventions
stories.outcome: Use canonical scope-relative cash, Item charge/credit and paired Transfer contributions, not source Sale/paymentToBusiness multipliers. Preserve signed amount and exact category/cycle provenance; never manufacture movement Transactions or count settlement cash twice.

stories.title: Pin and unpin personal budget rows
stories.outcome: Preserve Pin/Unpin and ordering for one Principal/Project under O-040, including Overall, absence versus explicit empty, first-view Furnishings, stale/deleted/archived IDs and zero-activity cases. Do not copy the magic sentinel or automatic writes as approved policy.

stories.title: Keep budget changes durable and conflict-aware
stories.outcome: Keep accepted allocation/category edits and ordering durable across restart; replay once, expose stale/conflicting/rejected results and retain drafts/evidence. One operation cannot report success after partial ordering/setup. Shared and Project permissions remain distinct; recovery uses shared policy.

stories.title: Represent nonphysical receipt lines
stories.outcome: Represent ordered receipt lines with stable unique UUIDs, source description, positive line-total magnitude, increase/decrease effect and optional quantity evidence. Reject empty descriptions/invalid magnitudes/duplicate IDs. Quantity does not redefine totals; no fixed cost taxonomy or fake physical Items.

stories.title: Reconcile receipt completeness exactly
stories.outcome: Determine final-amount completeness from qualifying physical Item evidence plus signed receipt lines, not subtotal/rate or percentage tolerance. Keep exact residual visible for Purchase and Return; the one-cent verdict and physical tax basis await O-030/O-031. Billability is a separate decision.

stories.title: Preserve non-Item line lifecycle
stories.outcome: Keep each line on its original Transaction or Expense receipt owner through physical Item movement. Never create Item IDs, Space/status/media/lineage or automatically copy lines into another Project/Invoice. Preserve order/references and frozen history; billing and non-cash adjustments use separate stories.

stories.title: Migrate non-Item receipt evidence
stories.outcome: Complete canonical receipt import/readiness under approved treatment, basis and posting rules. Retain raw source/media, signed equations, parent/Invoice/marker references and explicit quarantine; reruns duplicate neither lines nor media. Preservation/quarantine checks may proceed before final promotion.

stories.title: Interpret payments relative to the scope owner
stories.outcome: Project Purchases and Returns record Client money; Inventory Purchases and Returns record Business money. An Invoice is a demand, not proof of payment.

stories.title: Record a direct Client-paid purchase
stories.outcome: Create the Project Transaction immediately; physical Items belong to Furnishings and non-itemized costs use the selected category. Neither enters Invoicing.

stories.title: Acquire Business-paid physical goods
stories.outcome: Create the Inventory acquisition with Items and receipt evidence. Selling an Item into a Project creates an invoiceable Item charge without a second Project Purchase.

stories.title: Capture a Business-paid non-itemized Project cost
stories.outcome: Capture vendor, date, amount, receipt, notes and category as an Expense in Invoicing; create the Project Transaction only when the Invoice is paid.

stories.title: Keep Additional Requests non-additive
stories.outcome: Item charges and credits remain Furnishings; Additional Requests is an overlay and must not duplicate the amount in overall spend.

stories.title: Edit an Expense according to its lifecycle
stories.outcome: Preserve vendor, amount, receipt, notes and category while enforcing approved edit rules for available, invoiced and collected Expenses.

stories.title: Handle manual Invoice adjustments explicitly
stories.outcome: Allow only the approved adjustment types and categories; never hide a source-less amount inside an Invoice.

stories.title: Resolve credit-only and zero-dollar Invoices
stories.outcome: Verify three separate branches under their approved rules: credit-only settlement, nonempty net-zero settlement, and an empty Invoice after final-line removal (including created versus sent state). Never treat zero or negative demand as a positive cash Purchase.

stories.title: Revise and deliver a sent Invoice
stories.outcome: Apply approved sent-membership changes, preserve revision/delivery evidence and prevent collection against an invalid sent revision.

stories.title: Keep receipt evidence with the actual purchase
stories.outcome: Retain vendor, date, final amount, image, physical and nonphysical receipt details on the actual Transaction or Expense. Moving Items never manufactures a separate Receipt entity or silently reallocates receipt-wide costs.

stories.title: Choose how receipt costs become billable
stories.outcome: Apply explicit approved treatment to tax, shipping, warranty, discounts and credits instead of copying Transaction-wide amounts into an Item charge.

stories.title: Record an actual vendor cash refund
stories.outcome: When a scope owner actually receives vendor money, record a Return in that owner’s scope. Validate the approved canonical posting evidence; a vendor cancellation or non-cash account credit belongs to the separate vendor-adjustment story.

stories.title: Settle Client credit without fabricating cash
stories.outcome: Keep pending credit as non-cash evidence; use approved Invoice application or actual cash refund with linked settlement and a Return only when the Client receives money.

stories.title: Post and correct Transactions without erasing history
stories.outcome: Route Transaction detail/list edit, cancel, delete and correction through approved posting rules with exact selection, confirmation, denied/canceled/error and success navigation. Preserve paid history and audit; never treat a mistaken association as a sale/refund or duplicate a screen-specific writer.

stories.title: Keep placement and accounting relationships distinct
stories.outcome: Preserve acquisition, current placement, open billing, live and paid Invoice membership, frozen Transaction membership and provenance as distinct relationships; cross-record changes are atomic and retry-safe.

stories.title: Inspect all pending local work
stories.outcome: Before ending or removing a session, produce one environment/Principal/Account-bound summary with exact queued, applying, unresolved-rejected operation counts and captured bytes whose upload is unverified.

stories.title: Log out only after a fresh clean summary
stories.outcome: Allow ordinary logout only when every pending class is zero; detect new accepted work or a changed summary before teardown so a stale clean decision cannot discard work.

stories.title: Keep sync-first logout pending until work settles
stories.outcome: Keep the session open until a fresh same-scope summary proves authoritative or explicitly resolved operations and verified or explicitly resolved captured attachments.

stories.title: Confirm exactly which pending work is removed
stories.outcome: Destructive local removal is the only path allowed to discard pending work. Require explicit confirmation bound to the exact current scope, summary and counts; invalidate changed evidence and never claim discarded work reached the server.

stories.title: Cancel logout without starting teardown
stories.outcome: Cancel or close the prompt without an end-session request. Signout, sync shutdown, queue/media/database/key removal, cache cleanup and cleanup recovery remain behind coordinated teardown; no feature may invoke them independently.

stories.title: Resume interrupted cleanup before protected data reopens
stories.outcome: Treat termination, token expiry, revocation and interrupted cleanup as no destructive consent. Resume fail-closed cleanup before the same Principal can reopen protected local data.

stories.title: Carry Fee demand through Invoice collection
stories.outcome: Planned Fees remain visible in Invoicing and contribute once to unpaid progress, whether available or on a live Invoice. Collection freezes their membership/category value into paid contents and removes active demand without double-counting spend.

stories.title: Record vendor cancellation or account credit without fake cash
stories.outcome: Use the approved non-cash adjustment representation and settlement rules for vendor cancellation or account credit. Do not invent a fourth Transaction type or a Return before the scope owner receives money.

stories.title: Define what Client Summary totals represent
stories.outcome: Use the approved paid/open/physical-value meanings and category breakdown in Client Summary. Do not label active physical Item prices as Client cash paid or silently omit Expenses, Fees, credits, collections or Transfers.

stories.title: Share receipt evidence only through the approved report policy
stories.outcome: Apply the approved eligibility and durable delivery rules for receipt evidence in client-shared reports. Do not embed raw private object paths, expiring Storage tokens or unintended internal evidence in a PDF.

stories.title: Show Item charges and credits without movement jargon
stories.outcome: In Project Invoicing, show positive charges, negative credits and available, live-Invoice or paid states. Keep useful Item history understandable without asking users to manage an Item Movement entity.

stories.title: Explain the exact sale or return cycle
stories.outcome: Retain exact cycle, source/destination and category snapshots, signed amount/price basis, reversed occurrence, Invoice/line membership and open/paid/reversed/corrected state. An Invoice line identifies both Item and occurrence; one mutable transactionId cannot own every relationship.

stories.title: Freeze exact Item membership at collection
stories.outcome: Whole-Invoice collection atomically freezes Item/occurrence IDs, signed amount, category, label and price snapshot; attaches each occurrence to the single Purchase, removes active demand and leaves placement unchanged. Retries, concurrent return and price edits cannot duplicate or rewrite paid evidence.

stories.title: Use Add Item and Link language
stories.outcome: Add Item opens one wizard; Quick is its lightweight completion, not another object or writer. Use Unaccounted For Items, Accounted For Items and Link; do not expose proto, draft, conversion, promotion, Needs Assignment, Assign Item, Unlinked Items or Linked Items as target labels.

stories.title: Continue from capture into optional details
stories.outcome: In the same wizard optionally enter SKU, vendor/source, purchase price, project price, market value, status, acquisition Purchase and accounting Link. Preserve the saved Item ID while adding details; payer guidance remains subject to the separate open hint decision.

stories.title: Seed the same Item flow from each entry point
stories.outcome: Project capture starts in that Project with optional Space; Inventory capture has no Project. Transaction capture preselects only an eligible scope/type. Images and MCP extracted fields seed the same real-Item wizard/writer, not a separate product object.

stories.title: Browse shared Item lists, cards and details
stories.outcome: Preserve contextual Item sections/counts, list/card/detail, query/sort/facets/grouping, visible selection/totals and picker-only behavior with honest readiness. Show exact identity, placement and occurrence-based history; keep detail bookmark/filter, not an unwired card toggle. Edits use owning workflows.

stories.title: Review or cancel either Link route
stories.outcome: Link asks Who paid for this Item? with only Client paid and Business paid. Closing leaves the Item Unaccounted For with no side effects; there is no Not sure yet option. Review the exact accounting destination/effect before commit. Never label Business paid as Sell from Business Inventory.

stories.title: Save a real Item without accounting demand
stories.outcome: Allow a project Item with enabled Furnishings category, no Transaction or occurrence and optional prices/vendor/SKU/status/Space. Category alone is not accounting. Unaccounted For Items contribute nothing to budget, Invoice, Transaction completeness, reports or exports; later Link preserves identity.

stories.title: Reconcile duplicate evidence explicitly
stories.outcome: Use a separate audited Reconcile Existing Item action when receipt/MCP/migration reveals duplicates. Choose one surviving ID, merge media/evidence deterministically, redirect only mutable relationships and preserve paid history. Never force matching into normal Link or merge silently.

stories.title: Use the same Item contract in MCP
stories.outcome: MCP uses the app’s minimum-field real-Item writer and one trusted idempotent command per Link route, with target Item/Link names. Automation may suggest payer, Purchase, duplicates or details but never Links, migrates or merges silently. Existing source tools remain unchanged until authorized cutover.

stories.title: Rehearse target intake without changing Firebase
stories.outcome: Before authorized cutover, keep production Firebase app/MCP, proto documents, fields, media cleanup, rules and indexes unchanged. Test the full target and import repeatedly in isolated Supabase/PowerSync using immutable fixtures; target-only Item writes never reach Firebase or its users.

stories.title: Open target writers only after the approved gate
stories.outcome: Keep target production writers disabled until the approved compatibility/authority gate passes, including app/MCP/nonfinancial projections, reconciled legacy proto dispositions and final stale-writer freeze/recovery. Opening production authority is separately authorized, not implied by passing local tests.

stories.title: Make intake and Link safe under retries and competing edits
stories.outcome: Validate scope, identity/placement/accounting state, Purchase eligibility, occurrence uniqueness, category, charge price, live Invoice and authority version at commit. Creation/Link/reconciliation leave no partial records or retry duplicates; delete/move/Transfer/collection/price races fail or serialize.

stories.title: Create a Project and its new Client
stories.outcome: Create the chosen new Client and the Project’s authoritative relationship, categories and exact allocations through one observable setup result. Require approved Client/Project names and authorization; do not fall back to free-text ownership or leave silently incomplete setup.

stories.title: Update or clear Project description
stories.outcome: UpdateProjectDetails trims edge whitespace and clears a whitespace-only description. It changes only description, never names, categories, media, lifecycle, children or accounting. Preserve save/cancel and durable outcome rather than swallowing background failures.

stories.title: Restore an archived Project
stories.outcome: Offer distinct confirmed restore for the selected archived Project, preserving identity, children and history and returning it to Active. Cancel leaves it unchanged; expose pending/failure instead of treating restore as archive or silently losing it. Keep source-navigation parity distinct from target layout.

stories.title: Choose Project categories without losing the draft
stories.outcome: Show ordered active eligible categories with Itemized/Fee badges and no General badge. Preselect once without overwriting later choices; require at least one for new setup. Back preserves draft; deselection removes its draft allocation. Existing zero-category Projects remain valid readable states.

stories.title: Create an Account category from Project setup
stories.outcome: Add Category is an authorized shared Account mutation under O-026, not permission implied by Project creation. On success expose it Account-wide and select its returned stable ID in the draft; surface failures. Canceling Project setup must not silently delete a separately created shared category.

stories.title: Choose, replace and retry the Project image
stories.outcome: Show optional image selection/preview and existing-image loading or placeholder. Retain bytes and thumbnail work across restart until verified upload, with retryable failure independent of Project creation. Replace without silently purging shared/history bytes; no new remove control is implied.

stories.title: Preserve Project form navigation and outcomes
stories.outcome: Prefill edit values; preserve data across Back/Next, required-field/category guards, optional fields and cancel-without-Project-change. Missing Account, save failure, pending work and conflicts must be visible; do not copy immediate dismissal with suppressed background errors.

stories.title: Export the intended Project Transactions
stories.outcome: Project Options opens CSV export for current Transactions filters only when invoked from that tab; otherwise export all Project Transactions. Bind export to the exact Project and honest data readiness, not a silently incomplete or wrong-scope snapshot.

stories.title: Capture and manage Project notes
stories.outcome: Keep Notes and Quick Note distinct from description: capture multiline text, send, edit stable-ID records and confirm/cancel deletion. Preserve metadata, newest-first notes, input on empty state and attempted text on failure. Share approved app/MCP text rules; never silently drop accepted notes.

stories.title: Preserve initial and legacy Project notes
stories.outcome: Retain initial Project.notes content and individual notes separately from description, including source correlation and existing metadata. Show legacy content without inventing author/time or merging distinct records; replay/import must not duplicate or discard notes.

stories.title: Capture initial notes during Project creation
stories.outcome: Preserve optional initial Notes alongside description during Project creation. Retain its content and distinct meaning in durable setup and later notes display; do not drop the field or turn it into description. Apply the approved Project-note text contract.

stories.title: Update Space name and notes
stories.outcome: Prefill name and multiline notes; preserve Save/Cancel and required-name feedback. Replace the complete normalized name/optional-notes pair for exact Space ID/revision; whitespace-only notes clear. Never change immutable scope; stale edits conflict visibly and accepted intent survives restart.

stories.title: Search Space names
stories.outcome: Preserve case-insensitive name containment in both scoped browsers, query clearing and distinct no-Spaces versus no-matches states. Freeze shared cross-platform matching/normalization before verification; a filtered incomplete cache cannot establish that no matching Space exists.

stories.title: Show complete Space cards
stories.outcome: Show name, authorized primary/first image or honest placeholder, Item count and checklist progress. Zero Items requires complete visibility-safe evidence; missing/stale/partial Item or media data remains unavailable. Checklist progress never substitutes for the separate Space completion flag.

stories.title: Create a Space from a real template
stories.outcome: Select an authorized stable template in the exact creation scope, copy notes and ordered checklists with every task unchecked, then allow customization. Replace the unavailable-picker stub with real loading/empty/failure states; template use never grants shared-template mutation authority.

stories.title: Save a Space checklist as a template
stories.outcome: Save the selected Space checklist structure as a real new shared template, resetting every checked value. Preserve cancel and visible pending/failure; never report success without durable acceptance. Keep the source Space unchanged and authorize shared-template creation separately.

stories.title: Clear Item placement
stories.outcome: Clear selected Items in one common Project-or-Inventory scope, even from different current Spaces. Validate each exact revision/current Space and apply all-or-nothing/idempotently; close old-photo green Item links without deleting images/bytes or changing red review notes and accounting.

stories.title: Choose an exact-scope placement destination
stories.outcome: Show only active exact-scope Spaces with stable IDs/revisions, deterministic name order and current-selection mark. No Space clears placement; Close cancels. Distinguish complete empty from partial/stale/failed evidence; missing cached rows never prove no destination or grant authorization.

stories.title: Resolve rejected checklist work
stories.outcome: Retain the exact accepted checklist intent and rejection across restart; review and close cannot erase it. Corrective retry or do-not-retry resolution must follow approved O-051 responsibility and evidence rules, separate from canceling an unaccepted editor draft.

stories.title: Expose shared Space operations through MCP
stories.outcome: App and MCP use the same typed Space creation, details, checklist and Item-placement commands with identical validation, scope, revision, authorization and durable outcomes. MCP cannot bypass role decisions or reinterpret missing local evidence; UI-only checks do not prove this story.

stories.title: Manage Space photos durably
stories.outcome: Add uncapped Space images with durable local bytes, upload/retry and visible failure; select primary media for detail/cards. Remove only the authorized reference under approved retention rules, never assume immediate byte deletion. Preserve stable media identity across upload and restart.

stories.title: Inspect and print Space media
stories.outcome: Preserve media expand/collapse, image/PDF pinning, navigation, zoom/pan and unpin controls from the exact-control catalog. Print only resolved non-uploading images with loading/failure feedback; PDFs never expose photo matching. Missing offline bytes must be visible, not pretend available.

stories.title: Match Items to Space photos
stories.outcome: Use stable photo/Item identities for single and grouped one/two-location green markers. Preserve cancel/redo/save gating, move/reassign/remove and clear-all across photos, not just the pinned one. Persist visibly across offline restart; keep red review-note marks and Space completion separate.

stories.title: Record Space review observations
stories.outcome: Create/edit/delete text observations, newest-first with author/date and optional same-Space photo/red marker. Preserve text-only notes, photo selection/change/removal, marker positioning and failure drafts. Do not mix general notes, Project Notes, green Item markers or duplicate image bytes.

stories.title: Resolve manual Space completion behavior
stories.outcome: Account for the existing Mark space complete/incomplete control and persisted reconciliation flag, independently of checklist and photo-match progress. Its target meaning is not approved: preserve source evidence and require an explicit preserve/redesign/retire decision before claiming completion.

stories.title: Open and add Items within a Space
stories.outcome: Preserve exact-Space Item list/count, shared search/sort/filter/group/selection, Item detail or unavailable state, Create New preassigned to this Space and Add Existing Items. Delegate accounting and placement to their shared commands; never change immutable scope through navigation.

stories.title: Browse category settings
stories.outcome: Show authorized active and archived non-system categories separately, ordered active rows, badges, edit/archive/restore entries and distinct empty states. Cached partial data is not complete absence; preserve stable IDs and historic labels without leaking hidden Fee names or totals.

stories.title: Archive or restore a category safely
stories.outcome: Confirm archive or restore an exact category through authorized durable commands. Remove from new selection without losing historical category meaning; protect system rows and all accounting dependencies, not only Transactions. Failed or stale mutations stay visible, never hard-delete used history.

stories.title: Reorder shared categories atomically
stories.outcome: Drag eligible category rows and submit one complete expected-revision order. Disabled rows remain immovable; duplicate/missing IDs, concurrent edits and failures are visible. Apply all-or-nothing across Account readers; do not reproduce independent silent per-row writes.

stories.title: Apply defaults only to eligible entry routes
stories.outcome: Preserve protected idempotent Account category seeds and an authorized configurable default where selection is permitted. Physical Item demand remains Furnishings and collected payment categories remain frozen allocations; defaults cannot override writer eligibility or create duplicate seeds.

stories.title: Show the intended Project card and pinned header
stories.outcome: Display authorized amounts and ordered personal preview rows with honest readiness. Resolve pinned, no-pin, Furnishings/overall fallback and zero-activity behavior under O-040; source UI and old spec differ. A preview cannot hide missing data behind authoritative zero or expose restricted values.

stories.title: Explain category and overall budget progress
stories.outcome: Show each eligible category's paid/unpaid amounts, signed total, remaining/over and zero/null-budget state, plus overall and non-additive overlays. Preserve information affordances and overflow without implying unpaid Fees were received. Negative-credit display remains O-005; expose incomplete data.

stories.title: Choose only categories valid for the operation
stories.outcome: Bind category choice to the exact Account/Project and writer's allowed types/visibility/enabled state. Offer No Category only where valid; Close preserves state. Keep stable selection and empty/incomplete/error states; generic source picker options do not authorize invalid category or auto-enablement.

stories.title: Explain incomplete and historical budget values
stories.outcome: Rebuild projections from canonical contributions with local freshness/completeness and exact category/source evidence. Keep archived history explainable; missing categories or permissions cannot silently drop value. Withhold complete totals when evidence is unresolved, while showing honest allowed partial data.

stories.title: Open Project budget management from the right context
stories.outcome: Preserve Budget-tab no-configuration state, category/overall rows and eligible Manage Budget entry from its host. Open the exact Project's allocation flow without changing selection or writing defaults merely by viewing; capability and local readiness govern availability.

stories.title: Edit Other receipt lines
stories.outcome: Save Other receipt lines on eligible Transaction/Expense parents under approved locks and authorization: wording, effect, amount, optional quantity, stable edit/remove and order. Preserve unaccepted draft/cancel and failed input; accepted app/MCP saves survive restart. Read-only detail is separate.

stories.title: Explain the exact receipt equation
stories.outcome: Show physical Item sum separately from increase/decrease/net line totals, reconstructed final amount and exact signed residual, in audit/next steps and MCP. Tax/no-tax never requires a positive tax rate or inferred subtotal. Distinguish unknown basis/history from numerical zero; verdict is separate.

stories.title: Export receipt-line evidence
stories.outcome: Export authorized Transaction/Expense receipt evidence as readable and structured ordered lines, with applicable audit totals. Preserve identity, source wording, sign, magnitude and quantity; never flatten away details or present hidden/incomplete evidence as complete. Client sharing is separate.

stories.title: Preserve parsed receipt adjustments
stories.outcome: Preserve parsed shipping/tax/refunds/warranties/discounts/credits with stable source/candidate provenance and order through review. Retrying must not duplicate canonical lines or media. Ambiguity remains reviewable, never a fake Item; posting uses the approved parent workflow.

stories.title: Use the same receipt model in app and MCP
stories.outcome: Complete app/MCP receipt saves share validation, Transaction/Expense authorization/locks and durable outcomes. Readers retain ordered lines on editable and frozen parents plus applicable audit totals. Retire target discount arguments and advice to create fake Items; unaccepted drafts remain separate.

stories.title: Read ordered receipt details without edit permission
stories.outcome: Show ordered individual lines on authorized Transaction and Expense detail, including posted/read-only/frozen parents: exact source wording, signed magnitudes, optional quantity and stable identity. Distinguish a known empty line array from missing/unmigrated/partial evidence; edit permission is not required.

stories.title: Use cached work without pretending it is complete
stories.outcome: Under approved offline access, show authorized cached records, budgets/audits and local search without a network wait. Distinguish partial, stale, failed, known-empty and uncached evidence; never infer complete history or report readiness from connectivity. Lease and financial scope remain separate gates.

stories.title: Keep offline edits durable and their status honest
stories.outcome: For otherwise-authorized supported edits, navigate only after durable local acceptance; show local failure, pending and authoritative outcomes across restart. Retry without duplicate effects; retain rejected intent without stalling unrelated work. Use each command's conflict rules; O-051 owns resolution.

stories.title: Capture and deliver attachments without losing originals
stories.outcome: Across create/detail flows, retain protected scoped bytes, stable ID, metadata and receipt before acceptance. Show after restart; privately upload/verify without duplicates and retry derivatives separately. URLs are not identity; missing pending bytes are visible errors. O-023 separately gates byte deletion.

stories.title: Sign in, join an Account and recover access
stories.outcome: Preserve email/Google signup/sign-in and error/loading controls, invite acceptance and zero-membership Account creation with safe retry. Use explicit Account selection after success. Network-only identity/recovery cannot masquerade as offline unlock; provider/linking policy remains O-057.

authority.section: Target Online Entry and Account Onboarding

stories.title: Reopen only authorized local work
stories.outcome: Open only the approved environment/Principal/Account working set under bounded offline authorization and local unlock. Local access neither refreshes server authority nor authorizes new downloads. Apply approved expiry/revocation, financial scope and recovery rules without cross-Account leakage or silent loss.

stories.title: Remove media without destroying shared or pending evidence
stories.outcome: Separate removing a parent reference from deleting bytes. Apply approved retention, authoritative shared-reference checks and recoverable quarantine before permanent deletion; preserve pending capture and history. Ordinary cleanup, retry and logout cannot bypass explicit pending-work disposition.

stories.title: Apply approved Fee and whole-Invoice visibility
stories.outcome: Use approved full/limited/none grants and explicit Fee IDs; unknown revenue fails closed. Whole Invoices hide when any protected Fee is unavailable; never partially redact. Classify target Invoicing sources, not legacy payment types or all Expenses. Mixed payments and manual adjustments remain gated.

stories.title: Keep hidden financial data out of every read path
stories.outcome: Enforce one approved visibility policy before server reads, sync downloads, local data/media, search/review, budgets, reports/exports and MCP. Hidden amounts/counts/names/Invoice IDs/provenance cannot leak. Reduce online grants promptly; offline cache and retained work follow O-058, not immediate revocation.

stories.title: Manage member roles and financial access safely
stories.outcome: Show authorized member directory/badges and Access editor: Role, Full/Limited/None, conditional Fee checklist, Invoice explanation, Save/progress/error/Cancel/empty states. Apply exact member/revision changes together under approved ownership/self-lockout rules; never silently drop archived Fee grants.

stories.title: Invite and revoke with the intended grant
stories.outcome: Preserve validated email, Employee/Admin and financial-access choices, Limited Fee checklist, pending invitation rows, Copy Link and confirmed Revoke. Show sending/revoking/failure without silent success. Apply approved actor/role/grant policy and safely reconcile acceptance through target identity.

stories.title: Import financial grants and visibility evidence faithfully
stories.outcome: Preserve source member/invite grants and derive target Fee/Invoice/frozen visibility evidence without broadening access or duplicating invites on rerun. Retain original provenance and authorized unresolved-classification reports; unknown revenue stays full-only. Final promotion uses approved target policy.

stories.title: Preview and deliver a complete authorized report
stories.outcome: Preserve per-kind entry, preview and PDF/print/share/CSV/MCP delivery from one complete authorized versioned/as-of snapshot. Resolve assets before pure rendering; show unknown/missing/error states. Use deterministic rows and protected scratch files cleaned after confirmed handoff, never original/user exports.

stories.title: Render the selected Invoice and its actual evidence
stories.outcome: Route the Invoice report entry through the existing Invoice browser. Render exact live or frozen paid contents, signed groups/totals, status, notes and revision evidence. A linked Purchase explains payment without adding demand again; never substitute generic Project arrays or current Item price repairs.

stories.title: Hand off Items grouped by Space
stories.outcome: Preserve Property Management preview/share with Project/address/date, Space groups plus No Space, Item name/SKU/market value, count/value footer and meaningful empty/failure states. Use current physical identities once, explicit unknown prices and complete authorized local evidence.

stories.title: Resolve and deliver the proposed Closeout report
stories.outcome: If approved for this release, render the agreed furnishings/savings, services, total, outstanding and optional original-budget narrative. Include the approved Item population and format; distinguish paid/open value and unknown evidence. Do not duplicate Client Summary or assume current budget is original.

stories.title: Explain demand, collection and outstanding value
stories.outcome: Preserve billing summary information using canonical signed live/frozen demand and real collection evidence, with no double counting, paid-status-only fallback or missing-price zero. Distinguish open/unbilled, invoiced, collected and outstanding; apply approved credit, amount, label and visibility rules.

stories.title: Apply reviewed contract-derived details and Fee schedules
stories.outcome: Review contract-derived Project fields and planned Fee schedules; use shared Project/Fee/Invoice commands for approved updates and optional created Invoice membership. Keep progress/failure observable and retries idempotent. Extraction is neither write authorization, a cash event nor a new accounting entity.

stories.title: Parse and review supported vendor PDFs offline
stories.outcome: Preserve local Amazon/Wayfair PDF selection, extraction/errors, summaries/warnings, include/exclude, description/quantity/unit-price edits, category, change/cancel and authorized debug controls. Keep source/row provenance and exact thumbnail binding; supported local review does not wait for expanded scope.

stories.title: Resolve expanded document capture and review scope
stories.outcome: Implement approved expanded capture/review only: camera/image OCR, pasted receipt text, broader field/row editing or tax controls. Expose unsupported/no-row/large/uncertain parsing honestly. Historical text-import code is absent; never add a new writer or force network parsing onto supported local PDFs.

stories.title: Commit reviewed imports with canonical accounting
stories.outcome: Confirm exact reviewed rows through approved payer/ownership, quantity, pricing and receipt rules. Durably accept intent/bytes/relationships before dismissal, retain pending/applied/rejected state and prevent duplicate records/media on retry. A vendor invoice is not automatically a project Client payment.

stories.title: Suggest vendors without changing source evidence
stories.outcome: Use approved Account-scoped vendor suggestions while preserving original source wording and honest unknown/archived/incomplete state. Shared preset mutation requires its own approved authority; adding a name neither installs a parser nor silently makes an unsupported invoice importable.

stories.title: Search authorized local text, SKUs and amounts
stories.outcome: Preserve focused/debounced query/Clear, Items/Transactions/Spaces counts and useful segment selection. Match documented text, normalized SKUs and magnitude dollar prefixes, refreshing on value changes. Distinguish initial/no-match/partial/stale/error, omit retired proto results and never leak hidden data.

stories.title: Open a search result in its real context
stories.outcome: Show Project/Inventory context and open exact Item/Transaction/Space identity through canonical detail readers, or entity-specific unavailable state. Preserve current Client/Space/accounting relationships and visibility-safe history; unknown payer is not inferred from placement.

stories.title: Select results and use owning operations
stories.outcome: Preserve exclusive Item/Transaction selection, segment-change clearing, counts/eligible totals, Copy ID(s) and Clear. Route status, Link/clear, Space, correction/movement and deletion through fresh approved owning commands; never implement a second Search writer or bypass paid/retention rules.

stories.title: Browse an explainable contextual review queue
stories.outcome: Preserve Review, contextual groups/counts, local query, eight sort choices and find scrolling. Use approved typed reasons and scope/grouping, not source isComplete or empty Item arrays. Distinguish globally caught-up, group-empty, query-no-match, incomplete/stale and unavailable evidence.

stories.title: Resolve review work through its owning workflow
stories.outcome: Open exact review identity with reason and canonical context. Use approved breadcrumb destinations and owning Link/placement/receipt/accounting commands, never generic Assign, proto promotion or silent rejection dismissal. Legacy capture migration and O-051 rejected-work resolution remain separate.

stories.title: Read and share the Client Summary's physical detail
stories.outcome: Preserve Project entry, business/Project/Client metadata, physical Items with category/Space detail, empty/populated/loading/failure and Share. Compose shared report delivery; financial meanings and receipt actions remain separate O-035/O-036 outcomes, not reasons to omit physical content.

stories.title: Resolve and retain vendor reporting capability
stories.outcome: Account for shipped MCP vendor totals/counts, total ordering and optional Project filter. Implement approved O-041 semantics or explicit retirement, not raw Transaction sums. Use shared authorized reporting with honest partial data and reconciled signs; no new Vendor entity, app screen or writer is implied.

stories.title: Browse and inspect real Transactions
stories.outcome: Preserve shared Project/Inventory search/sort/filter, cards/detail, selection/copy and honest readiness/financial visibility. Keep Project-only Add/select-all/export and Inventory-only planning distinct. Compose Item, receipt, media/history and owning mutation routes; a visible tab alone is not completion.

stories.title: Edit ordinary Item details safely
stories.outcome: Preserve rename/vendor/SKU/amounts/notes, four-state and clear-status controls, detail bookmark, bulk status and Copy ID(s). Save exact revisions with validation, paid-price locks, durable status and safe retry; Cancel/unchanged Save invent nothing. Relational and media actions use owning workflows.

stories.title: Create distinct physical copies without copied history
stories.outcome: Preserve Make Copies' 1–20 additional count, exact unsuffixed name, count-aware Create, Cancel and durable error/retry. Each new object has a stable distinct ID; duplicate submission creates no extras. Apply approved relationship/media inheritance without copying frozen Invoice/payment facts.
